= 07-05-2025 =
''EXE rev. 152859 (game)''<br />
''EXE rev. 152859 (Launcher)''<br />
''Size: ~77 MB''

'''DATA'''
* Fixed: Tail wheel missing from Camo2 hidden selection on UH-80 in first LOD
* Fixed: [[format]] related error in the "Remnants of War" campaign
* Added: New illumination flares to faction ammo boxes (several more factions to be done)

'''ENGINE'''
* Fixed: Animation skipping / freezing on long animations
* Tweaked: Improved game start speed
* Added: UVScale XY to Fisheye post processing effect - {{Link|https://feedback.bistudio.com/T163827|FT-T163827}}

= 30-04-2025 =
''EXE rev. 152843 (game)''<br />
''EXE rev. 152843 (Launcher)'' <br />
''Size: ~103 MB''

'''DATA'''
* Fixed: AI jet pilots will now properly eject from their plane when it is damaged more then its ''ejectDamageLimit''
* Fixed: One pop-up target in CoF: Red 2 was behaving incorrectly
* Fixed missing windows fire geometry on armed variants of Ifrit - {{Link|https://feedback.bistudio.com/T190093|FT-T190093}}
* Stub-wing variants with pylon configurations for AH-99 and UH-80 helicopters
* Illumination flares (effects, attenuation, intensity, drag, Zeus modules, mortar variant)

'''ENGINE'''
* Tweaked: Improved efficiency of listbox sorting - {{Link|https://feedback.bistudio.com/T184005|FT-T184005}}
* Added: Listbox sorting is now multithreaded - {{Link|https://feedback.bistudio.com/T184005|FT-T184005}}
* Added: [[Arma_3:_Event_Handlers#PylonChanged|"PylonChanged"]] entity Event Handler - {{Link|https://feedback.bistudio.com/T190875|FT-T190875}}
* Added: Post-processing effects ''Sharpness'', ''DepthOfField'', ''Fisheye'' - {{Link|https://feedback.bistudio.com/T163827|FT-T163827}}
* Fixed: Flares did not apply the ''Attenuation'' config to their light emitter
* Tweaked: Improved netcode performance
* Added: Netcode fast retransmit on packet loss

= 09-04-2025 =
''EXE rev. 152791 (game)''<br />
''EXE rev. 152791 (Launcher)''<br />
''Size: ~76 MB''

'''DATA'''
* Fixed: SAAMI weapon referencing incorrect sounds - {{Link|https://feedback.bistudio.com/T185821|FT-T185821}}
* Fixed: Script format error in Field Manual - {{Link|https://feedback.bistudio.com/T182822|FT-T182822}}
* Fixed: Launchers were not always selected properly in Arsenal
* Tweaked: Eye position when aiming down the sights on M320 & GM6, so the camera is no longer clipping with the rifle's mesh when recoil kicks in

'''ENGINE'''
* Added: CfgAmmo ''explodeParentWhenTriggered'' to complement ''deleteParentWhenTriggered'' - {{Link|https://feedback.bistudio.com/T190390|FT-T190390}}
* Added: Mission [[Arma_3:_Mission_Event_Handlers#MarkerDeleted|"MarkerDeleted"]] Event Handler now returns deleter person - {{Link|https://feedback.bistudio.com/T178348|FT-T178348}}
* Tweaked: Handling of Eden Editor mouse placement (objects can be now placed on top of other objects, on side of other objects and upside down) (Experimental flag removed)
* Added: [[removeAllMagazines]] and [[removeAllMagazinesTurret]] script commands - {{Link|https://feedback.bistudio.com/T177284|FT-T177284}}
* Added: [[Arma_3:_Multi-Function_Display_(MFD)_config_reference#Sources|MFD Sources]] ''WPDir''/''WPDirRel''
* Added: [[addMagazinesTurret]] script command - {{Link|https://feedback.bistudio.com/T174007|FT-T174007}}
* Fixed: Forced game crash when addon requires addon that was skipped due to ''skipWhenMissingDependencies'' - {{Link|https://feedback.bistudio.com/T172179|FT-T172179}}
* Fixed: Showcase FFV helicopter would fail to land
* Added: Some of [[Arma_3:_Basic_Server_Config_File|basic.cfg]] network parameters can now be provided as strings
* Changed: Networking bandwidth estimation behavior of [[Arma_3:_Basic_Server_Config_File|Min/MaxBandwidth]] (Experimental builds only)
* Added: [[Arma_3:_Multi-Function_Display_(MFD)_config_reference#Sources|MFD Source]] ''WPTime''
* Added: [[connectToServer]] command and Server Browser Direct-Connect now supports resolving SRV records - {{Link|https://feedback.bistudio.com/T127943|FT-T127943}}
* Added: Scanning for objects in trigger areas is now multithreaded (Experimental flag removed)
* Added: Script commands [[allMissionObjects]], [[nearestObjects]], [[nearObjects]], [[nearSupplies]], [[nearRoads]] are now internally multithreaded (Experimental flag removed)
* Changed: AI computation is now done in parallel to d3dPresent (Experimental flag removed)
* Added: AI Sensor updating is now multithreaded (Experimental flag removed)
* Added: AI Target list updating/scanning is now multithreaded (Experimental flag removed)
* Added: PhysX Vehicle suspension update is now multithreaded (Experimental flag removed)
* Added: PhysX Simulation is now multithreaded
* Fixed: URL encoding for HTTP mission file downloads
* Added: HTTP header support for HTTP mission file downloads
* Fixed: [[getShotInfo]] did not return ''timeToExplosion'' for mines - {{Link|https://feedback.bistudio.com/T190684|FT-T190684}}
* Added: [[getAllPylonsInfo]] now also returns the position of each pylon - {{Link|https://feedback.bistudio.com/T190789|FT-T190789}}
* Fixed: Zeus did not store allowed addons in savegame (resulting in loss of access to modded units after loading a savegame) - {{Link|https://feedback.bistudio.com/T190333|FT-T190333}}

= 26-03-2025 =
''EXE rev. 152752 (game)''<br />
''EXE rev. 152752 (Launcher)''<br />
''Size: ~77 MB''

'''DATA'''
* Added: [[Arma 3: Steam Game Recording|Steam Game Recording]] integration for [[Arma 3: Time Trials|Time Trials]]
* Added: Steam Game Recording integration for [[Arma 3: Invaders|Arma Invaders]]
* Added: Steam Game Recording integration for [[Arma 3: Firing Drills|Firing Drills]]
* Fixed: Steam Game Recording Challenge Hit event was not respecting optional ''hitConditions'' for targets
* Tweaked: Steam Game Recording Challenge Bonus / Penalty events now mention the type as well

'''ENGINE'''
* Changed: Missile ''fuseDistance'' is now ignored for projectiles spawned by script - {{Link|https://feedback.bistudio.com/T189277|FT-T189277}}
* Tweaked: AI no longer calculates light influence on targets during daytime
* Added: ''AIThinkOnlyLocal'' option to [[setMissionOptions]]

= 19-03-2025 =
''EXE rev. 152743 (game)''<br />
''EXE rev. 152743 (Launcher)''<br />
''Size: ~81 MB''

'''DATA'''
* Tweaked: Pause menu Steam branch indicator was not positioned correctly when running an unmodded game
* Fixed: A Logic was created on the wrong side in a scripted function - {{Link|https://feedback.bistudio.com/T177680|FT-T177680}}

'''ENGINE'''
* Added: Mission file downloading over HTTP
* Fixed: Functions Viewer did not populate list of functions when opening
* Added: Animal config property ''canFitUnderADoor'' when true will stop given animal from opening a door when entering into a house
* Fixed: Incorrect laser marker positioning on and around water - {{Link|https://feedback.bistudio.com/T188547|FT-T188547}}
* Fixed: Laser target marker would get stuck on objects - {{Link|https://feedback.bistudio.com/T71322|FT-T71322}}
* Fixed: [[currentZeroing]] did not respect laser range zeroing - {{Link|https://feedback.bistudio.com/T189309|FT-T189309}}
* Fixed: Missiles did not consider their ''fuseDistance'' setting - {{Link|https://feedback.bistudio.com/T189277|FT-T189277}}
* Added: Initial integration of Steam Game Recording with custom game events
* Fixed: Crash when using [[loadConfig]] with binarized configs - {{Link|https://feedback.bistudio.com/T188760|FT-T188760}}
* Added: Option to [[removeWeapon]]/[[removeWeaponGlobal]] to abort a new weapon autoselect after primary weapon removal
* Added: Option to [[addWeapon]]/[[addWeaponGlobal]] to abort a new weapon autoselect if no weapon was selected
* Fixed: Crash if OGG sound file is played more than 255 times at once
* Fixed: [[Arma_3:_Event_Handlers#Fired|"Fired"]] Event Handler in multiplayer could receive wrong projectile for global projectiles - {{Link|https://feedback.bistudio.com/T190141|FT-T190141}}
